description: A reflector inside a flow: chain loop pass generates a plan that uses the json tool, which this document doesn't use anywhere itself. The refusal names the reflector by the run's absolute path (prime.shots.iter_0.plan_it), the same path the error's own prefix already uses -- a chain loop's own node_path was already absolute before #811's fix (only a tree loop's isolated branch store wasn't), so this case pins existing behaviour rather than a regression.
